name: GNK ASG Intelligence Desk
activation_hr: Povezani AI aktivan je putem Puter.js usluge bez javno izloženog API ključa. Pri prvom korištenju Puter može zatražiti prijavu korisnika.
activation_en: Connected AI is active through Puter.js without a publicly exposed API key. Puter may request user sign-in on first use.
privacy_hr: U Povezani AI ne upisujte osobne, povjerljive, porezne, ugovorne ni druge nejavne podatke. Vanjski AI odgovor obrađuje Puter.js i odabrani model pružatelja.
privacy_en: Do not enter personal, confidential, tax, contractual or other non-public data in Connected AI. External AI answers are processed through Puter.js and the selected model provider.
disclaimer_hr: AI odgovori su informativni i moraju se provjeriti prema javnim izvorima. Korištenje vanjskog AI načina podliježe korisničkim uvjetima i raspoloživosti Puter.js usluge.
disclaimer_en: AI answers are informational and must be verified against public sources. External AI mode is subject to Puter.js user terms and service availability.
